summary: 009FD570 is a standoff-ring controller, not a bearing helper: it returns the compass heading that flies a unit away from, around or in toward a point depending on range - standoff, with an obstacle-avoidance term and a map-edge term folded in. Its RET 0x18 says six stack arguments, which retracts docs/TORPEDO_AFTER_THE_DROP.md section 3.5's reading that approach->vtable[0] takes five of them: vtable[0] is RET 4 and takes only its return buffer. The torpedo break-off 009D0C10 and the goaway tick 009D0F10 are reconstructed on top of it.

corrections.was: 009FD570(state, approach->vtable[0](&scratch, unit, state+24h, &state+2Ch, approach+90h, 0.8)) - vtable[0] takes a return buffer plus five arguments and 009FD570 takes one, with the side passed by pointer to vtable[0]
corrections.is: approach->vtable[0] is RET 4 and takes only its return buffer; 009FD570 is RET 0x18 and takes all six. The five values are staged before the vtable[0] call and left across it. The side IS an in/out pointer, but it is 009FD570's, written at 009FDC48.
corrections.evidence: the stack balance of 009D0C10 walked backwards from its POP ESI / ADD ESP,0x3C at 009D0D83 with each callee's own RET imm (007F0280 RET 0x18, 00438B10/00438AA0 RET 8, 0074E260 bare RET) puts ESP at S-0x18 before CALL 009FD570; the six pushes before CALL EAX put ESP at S-0x18 too and PUSH EAX sits between them, so vtable[0] popped four bytes. Confirmed independently by 009C47D0's byte-identical call setup at 009C47D6-009C4810.

validation.result: deaths 5 -> 2, kill_credits 5 -> 2, hits taken 111 -> 59, damage taken 2596.8 -> 1501.9. All five aircraft climb away: world y in the goaway bottoms at 6.9 to 9.4 m and peaks at 47.7 to 57.7 m, against the previous run's descent to the water at 69.6 m/s. Mav2 and Mav3 finish at full health, Mav4 at 175/450; Mav1 and Mav5 are killed at 134.9 s and 129.7 s by Dunlap and SaltLakeCity.
validation.substitution_exposure: the commanded heading, the only output that depends on the unproved unit+AC8h lead vector, is published on 40 of 2586 goaway ticks; three of the five aircraft never publish it
validation.not_settled: goaway enters 1 -> 82 and transitions 3 -> 165, because the break-off now opens the range past 700 m and 009D3150 answers true. 009D4030's transition rule for a torpedo-less aircraft is not established to be the image's.

validation.claim: the image does not lead the torpedo through 009D1360
validation.method: byte census over .text with --limit 4000 (the default cap is 20 and truncated the first pass), four encodings per field plus the task+4F0h alias and the SIB forms
validation.result: approach+F8h has three stores (009D3D2F, 009D3D52, 009D3D65, all in 009D3420) and no read anywhere in the image; approach+98h is read only by 009D3D12; approach+A0h is read only by the release gate at 009D2044 and the getter 009D12D0
validation.positive_controls: the same encodings occur 20, 18, 9, 1, 2, 23 and 4 times elsewhere in .text, none of them in the bot-task band
validation.measured: cmd_2C0 == bearing_94 - 2pi exactly at every aim census, with turn_5c = 0, so the host commands the bare bearing to the target's present position; the escorts make 13.7 m/s and a 22.7 s run lets a 180 m hull move about 311 m
